text:
sam: hey devex, hitting a weird one on my first quickstart call. running inside WSL2 with a WireGuard tunnel. curl to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat returns 403 (payment_required) even though org shows trial + card added. anyone seen proxy/tunnel related fallout here?

maya: can you paste the exact curl you ran (mask the key) and the response body? also `env | grep -i proxy` output if you can

sam: sure — command I ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
response (trimmed):
```
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\r\n
{"error":"payment_required","message":"Org billing not active"}
```
and env proxies:
```
HTTP_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:3128
HTTPS_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:3128
no_proxy=localhost,127.0.0.1
```

maya: ahhh proxy env present. corporate proxies sometimes strip Authorization or rewrite headers. try bypassing proxy for api.redwood.ai: set `NO_PROXY=$NO_PROXY,api.redwood.ai` or run curl with `--noproxy api.redwood.ai` (or temporarily `unset HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY`) and retry. also confirm your $REDWOOD_API_KEY is the workspace key and not an unrelated token.

sam: doing `curl --noproxy api.redwood.ai -v ...` now. running...

sam: ok re-ran with --noproxy and got 200 👍
```
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n
{"id":"chatcmpl-xxxx","object":"chat.completion","output":"hello"}
```

sam: so the proxy was stripping the Authorization header and the API returned the generic billing error. scary because org UI looked fine. fwiw WireGuard wasn't the cause, it just put me on corp net where the proxy env was set.

maya: makes sense. two followups: 1) we'll add a note to the quickstart troubleshooting page about corporate proxies stripping auth headers (with the --noproxy tip). 2) consider adding an explicit error hint server-side when Authorization missing vs billing (logged only) — I'll file a tiny bug for ops to review.

irene: +1 on docs note. also throw in `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" --noproxy api.redwood.ai` as the minimal repro for users behind proxies.

sam: thanks y'all — saved my morning. will PR a docs snippet after lunch.

maya: amazing, thanks! :rocket:
